### mod twine_theme::lvgl::metrics

The LVGL theme's values that depend on the display: every size LVGL's `style_init()`
scales with `LV_DPX_CALC` by the display's DPI or picks by its size class
(`DisplaySize`). They are design elements — the standard spacings, radii and elevations
and the theme-private elements of this module — in one small table per display, computed
once when the display is created (`table`, what
`Lvgl::metrics` returns), so the theme's
styles are `static` and a mode switch never touches them.

| Element | Value | LVGL |
|---------|-------|------|
| `design::SPACE_XS`, `SPACE_S`, `SPACE_M` | `PAD_TINY`, `PAD_SMALL`, `PAD_DEF` (2/6/8, 10/12/14, 16/20/24 dp: small/medium/large display) | paddings |
| `design::SPACE_L` | 24 / 28 / 32 dp | — |
| `design::RADIUS_S`, `RADIUS_M`, `RADIUS_L` | `RADIUS_DEFAULT` / 2, `RADIUS_DEFAULT` (8 dp, 12 on large displays), · 2 | radii |
| `design::ELEVATION_*` | level 1: 3 dp wide, 3 dp down (the button shadow); 2: 8/4 dp; 3: 16/8 dp | — |
| `DP_1` … `DP_20` | `LV_DPX_CALC(n)` | `LV_DPX_CALC` |
| `DP_1_NEG`, `DP_4_NEG` | `-LV_DPX_CALC(1)`, `-LV_DPX_CALC(4)` | text area cursor, switch knob |
| `BORDER_WIDTH_X2`, `BORDER_WIDTH_NEG` | `BORDER_WIDTH * 2`, `-BORDER_WIDTH` | tab buttons |
| `BUTTON_RADIUS` | 8 / 12 / 16 dp | button radius |
| `KEY_RADIUS` | `RADIUS_DEFAULT` / 2 on small displays, else `RADIUS_DEFAULT` | keyboard keys |
| `KEYBOARD_PAD` | `PAD_SMALL` on large displays, else `PAD_TINY` | keyboard padding |
| `ROTARY_SENSITIVITY` | `dpi / 4 · 256` (in 1/256) | `rotary_sensitivity` |

`dp` here is LVGL's unit: pixels at 160 DPI, rounded like `LV_DPX_CALC`
(`dpx`).
(… see the full docs in rustdoc)

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_1
`pub const DP_1: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(1)`: card lines, menu and list borders.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_2
`pub const DP_2: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(2)`: LVGL's `BORDER_WIDTH` (cards, checkbox markers, the text area cursor).

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_3
`pub const DP_3: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(3)`: LVGL's `OUTLINE_WIDTH` (focus rings), the pressed grow, the checkbox marker padding. (The button shadow is `design::ELEVATION_1_*`, the same 3 dp.)

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_5
`pub const DP_5: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(5)`: scrollbar width, button gaps, the LED glow spread.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_6
`pub const DP_6: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(6)`: the knob padding.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_7
`pub const DP_7: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(7)`: the scrollbar padding.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_10
`pub const DP_10: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(10)`: the checkbox gap (`pad_gap`).

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_15
`pub const DP_15: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(15)`: arc width, the LED glow.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_20
`pub const DP_20: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`LV_DPX_CALC(20)`: large line spacing (rollers, dropdown lists).

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_1_NEG
`pub const DP_1_NEG: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`-LV_DPX_CALC(1)`: the text area cursor's left padding.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::DP_4_NEG
`pub const DP_4_NEG: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`-LV_DPX_CALC(4)`: the switch knob inset.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::BORDER_WIDTH_X2
`pub const BORDER_WIDTH_X2: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`BORDER_WIDTH * 2`: the selected tab's underline and its top padding.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::BORDER_WIDTH_NEG
`pub const BORDER_WIDTH_NEG: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
`-BORDER_WIDTH`: the focus outline of a tab bar, drawn inside.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::KEYBOARD_PAD
`pub const KEYBOARD_PAD: twine_style::design::LengthElement`
The keyboard's padding and gaps: `PAD_SMALL` on large displays, else `PAD_TINY`.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::BUTTON_RADIUS
`pub const BUTTON_RADIUS: twine_style::design::RadiusElement`
The button radius: 8, 12 or 16 dp (small, medium, large display).

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::KEY_RADIUS
`pub const KEY_RADIUS: twine_style::design::RadiusElement`
The radius of keyboard keys: `RADIUS_DEFAULT / 2` on small displays, else `RADIUS_DEFAULT`.

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::ROTARY_SENSITIVITY
`pub const ROTARY_SENSITIVITY: twine_style::design::ScaleElement`
The rotary (encoder) scroll sensitivity of screens and tab pages: `dpi / 4 · 256`.

#### fn twine_theme::lvgl::metrics::table
`pub fn table(dpi: u16, size: twine_theme::DisplaySize) -> twine_style::design::ElementTable`
The metrics table of a display with `dpi` (at least 1) and size class `size`: every element of the module documentation. Built once per display (it allocates the table's private slots); never panics.

### mod twine_theme::lvgl::styles

The styles of the LVGL theme, LVGL's `style_init()` of
`src/themes/default/lv_theme_default.c` as `static` data (every value cites its LVGL
line): in flash, built while compiling, shared by every node and display.

Nothing in them depends on the mode or the display: every color is a
design element of the mode's table (values in
`lvgl`'s documentation) and every size LVGL scales by the DPI or the display size
class is an element of the display's metrics table. Applications reuse
them in their own recipes, so custom widgets look native:


Two fixed colors remain, on purpose: the `PRESSED` recolor is black (a darkening, the same
in every mode), and the `LED` style's white and grey are brightness masks the LED replaces
with its own color (the LED's color is `design::PRIMARY` by default).

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::styles::TRANSITION_TIME
`pub const TRANSITION_TIME: twine_core::Duration`
`LV_THEME_DEFAULT_TRANSITION_TIME` (80 ms in `lv_conf_template.h`).

#### const twine_theme::lvgl::styles::TRANS_PROPS
`pub const TRANS_PROPS: twine_style::Props`
`trans_props` of `style_init()`: the properties the theme's transitions animate (LVGL's exact list, not whole groups: e.g. the checkbox's checked `bg_image` must switch at once, not at the end of a transition).

#### static twine_theme::lvgl::styles::TRANS_DELAYED
`pub static TRANS_DELAYED: twine_style::Transition`
`lv_style_transition_dsc_init(&theme->trans_delayed, trans_props, lv_anim_path_linear, TRANSITION_TIME, 70, NULL)`: going back to the default state waits 70 ms.

#### static twine_theme::lvgl::styles::TRANS_NORMAL
`pub static TRANS_NORMAL: twine_style::Transition`
`lv_style_transition_dsc_init(&theme->trans_normal, trans_props, lv_anim_path_linear, TRANSITION_TIME, 0, NULL)`.

### mod twine_theme::mono

`Mono`: LVGL's monochrome theme (`src/themes/mono/lv_theme_mono.c`) for 1-bit displays,
as `static` data. Every color is pure black or pure white, so `I1` output is exact.

The foreground and background colors are design elements
(`ON_SURFACE` and `SURFACE` / `BACKGROUND`) of one `'static` table per mode
(`LIGHT`, `DARK`, `NIGHT`, `HIGH_CONTRAST`, or `MonoSet::table`), so the theme
supports every mode, switched at run time with
`Engine::set_theme_mode`:
`ThemeMode::Light` (black on white) and `ThemeMode::Dark` (white on black, LVGL's
`dark_bg`); a 1-bit panel can only invert, so `ThemeMode::Night` is white on black (the
least lit pixels; dimming is the backlight's job) and `ThemeMode::HighContrast` black on
white (every pair is 21:1 in every mode). Its sizes do not depend on the display (no
metrics table). The styles are the `static`s of `styles`, the per-class looks one
`ComputedRecipe` per widget class (`ALL_RECIPES`, or the ones the application lists
with `Mono::recipes`: only those are linked).

#### static twine_theme::mono::LIGHT
`pub static LIGHT: twine_style::design::ElementTable`
Black on white with the default font (`Mono::SET.table(ThemeMode::Light)`).

#### static twine_theme::mono::DARK
`pub static DARK: twine_style::design::ElementTable`
White on black (`Mono::SET.table(ThemeMode::Dark)`; LVGL's `dark_bg`).

#### static twine_theme::mono::NIGHT
`pub static NIGHT: twine_style::design::ElementTable`

### mod twine_theme::simple

`Simple`: LVGL's simple theme (`src/themes/simple/lv_theme_simple.c`), as `static` data.

Its colors are design elements (`COLOR_WHITE` = `SURFACE`,
`COLOR_LIGHT` = `SURFACE_VARIANT`, `COLOR_DARK` = `PRIMARY`, `COLOR_DIM` = `ON_SURFACE`,
`COLOR_SCR` = `BACKGROUND`) of one `'static` table per mode (`LIGHT`, `DARK`,
`NIGHT`, `HIGH_CONTRAST`), so an application recolors it with its own tables
(`SimpleSet::table` plus `ElementTable`'s const builders).

| Mode | Look |
|------|------|
| `ThemeMode::Light` | LVGL's: a light grey screen, white containers, grey buttons and tracks, dark grey text |
| `ThemeMode::Dark` | Twine's: the same flat tones inverted — `#121212` screen, `#1E1E1E` containers, `#3A3A3A` tracks, mid-grey buttons and indicators, light grey knobs and text |
| `ThemeMode::Night` | Twine's: dim, warm amber on near-black (every color ≤ 30 % relative luminance, blue ≤ red / 2) |
| `ThemeMode::HighContrast` | black text on white, black knobs and scrollbars, darker status colors |

LVGL's simple theme has no borders or outlines. Its styles put the text color
`ON_SURFACE` (not `ON_PRIMARY`) on `PRIMARY` buttons, so the high-contrast `PRIMARY` is a
mid grey that black text reads on at 7.8:1, and the dark and night `PRIMARY` a dark tone
their light text reads on; for a high-contrast UI with clearly outlined controls prefer
`Lvgl`. Its sizes do not depend on the display (no metrics table).

#### static twine_theme::simple::LIGHT
`pub static LIGHT: twine_style::design::ElementTable`
LVGL's look with the default font (`Simple::SET.table(ThemeMode::Light)`).

#### static twine_theme::simple::DARK
`pub static DARK: twine_style::design::ElementTable`
The flat grey tones inverted (`Simple::SET.table(ThemeMode::Dark)`).

#### static twine_theme::simple::NIGHT
`pub static NIGHT: twine_style::design::ElementTable`
Dim, warm amber on near-black (`Simple::SET.table(ThemeMode::Night)`).

#### static twine_theme::simple::HIGH_CONTRAST

## crate twine_style

Documented with features: `std`.

**twine-style**

The style system of the Twine GUI library, independent of the widget tree: the complete
LVGL v9 style property catalogue, flash-resident and heap styles, selectors, the exact LVGL
resolution (precedence and inheritance) algorithm over an abstract `StyleSource`, and
transitions (`Transition`, property sets `Props`) with interpolation.

No floating point and no allocation during resolution.

**Defining styles**

```rust
use twine_core::{Color, Opa};
use twine_style::{Length, PropId, Style, StyleBuf, StyleValue, style};

// In flash: a `static` built by the `style!` macro.
static CARD: Style = style! { bg_color: Color::WHITE, bg_opacity: Opa::COVER, radius: 8, padding: 12 };
// On the heap, e.g. built by a theme at run time.
let accent = StyleBuf::new().bg_color(Color::hex(0x2196F3)).border_width(2);
assert_eq!(CARD.get(PropId::PaddingTop), Some(StyleValue::Length(Length::Px(12))));
assert_eq!(accent.get(PropId::BorderWidth), Some(StyleValue::Length(Length::Px(2))));
```

Styles compose: `..BASE` in `style!` spreads another `static`/`const` style (merged at
compile time, later keys win, still in flash); `Style::merge` and
`StyleBuf::extend_from` compose at run time.

```rust
use twine_core::Color;
use twine_style::{PropId, Style, StyleValue, style};

static BUTTON: Style = style! { bg_color: Color::WHITE, radius: 8, padding: 12 };
static DANGER_BUTTON: Style = style! { ..BUTTON, bg_color: Color::RED };
assert_eq!(DANGER_BUTTON.get(PropId::BgColor), Some(StyleValue::Color(Color::RED)));
assert_eq!(DANGER_BUTTON.props().len(), BUTTON.props().len()); // overridden in place
```

A card that shrinks slightly and darkens while pressed, with a transition (the widget and
view parts that attach these to a node come from the engine and view crates):

```rust
use twine_core::{Color, Duration, Opa, Scale};
use twine_style::{Length, Props, Radius, Style, Transition, style};

pub static CARD: Style = style! {
    bg_color: Color::WHITE,
    bg_opacity: Opa::COVER,
    radius: Radius::Px(8),
    padding: Length::dp(12),  // shorthand → padding_top/bottom/left/right; 12 dp scale with the DPI
    shadow_width: 12,
    shadow_opacity: Opa::P30,
};
// Pressing animates what the pressed style changes (background and scale): no list needed.
pub static SMOOTH: Transition = Transition::all(Duration::ms(150)).ease_out();
pub static CARD_PRESSED: Style =
    style! { bg_color: Color::hex(0xEEEEEE), transform_scale: Scale::pct(98), transition: &SMOOTH };
// Or name the animated properties by group.
pub static FADE: Transition = Transition::of(Props::BG.union(Props::OPACITY), Duration::ms(200));
```

**Design elements**

Instead of a fixed value, a color, length, radius, opacity or font property can name a
design element (`design::SURFACE`, `design::SPACE_M`, …, or an application's own):
the display's theme gives it a value for its current `ThemeMode`, substituted when the
style is resolved. Switching the mode re-resolves the styles; nothing is rebuilt.

```rust
use twine_style::{StyleBuf, design};
let card = StyleBuf::new().bg(design::SURFACE).border(1, design::OUTLINE).padding(design::SPACE_M);
```

**Precedence**

A node carries a list of `StyleEntry`s, each with a `Selector` (part + states) and a
kind. `resolve` walks them in priority order (the outcome is LVGL 9's):

```rust
 entries of the node (highest priority first)            value of prop P for part X
 ┌──────────────────────────────┐
 │ Transition (part X)          │── has P ─────────────────────► wins immediately
 ├──────────────────────────────┤
 │ Local      (part, states)    │  every entry whose part is X and whose states are all
 │ Normal     latest added first│  active: the highest state precedence wins,
 │ Normal     …                 │  equal weight → the earlier entry; an entry whose states
 │ Theme      …                 │  equal the node's state stops the search
 └──────────────────────────────┘
        │ not found
        ▼
 inherited prop (text, base dir, color filter…)?
    yes → own Main part (if X ≠ Main), then each ancestor's Main part, same rules
    no  → default (PropMeta::default; Font → StyleDefaults::font)

 the value found is a design element → the theme's value (StyleSource::design_value;
 undefined → the default above); a Dp length → pixels (StyleSource::dpi)
```

**State precedence**

Among the entries whose states are all active, the selector with the higher state
precedence wins, whatever its kind (a theme's pressed style beats a local default-state
property). The states are ranked by `State::PRECEDENCE`; **the highest-ranked state in
which two selectors differ decides**, so one state outranks every combination of the
states below it, and adding a state to a selector makes it more specific:

| Rank (low → high) | States |
|-------------------|--------|
| – | no state (`DEFAULT`, or `State::ANY` in a selector) |
| 0–4 | `ALT`, `CHECKED`, `FOCUSED`, `FOCUS_KEY`, `EDITED` |
| 5–8 | `HOVERED`, `PRESSED`, `SCROLLED`, `DISABLED` |
| 9–12 | the application's states `State::custom::<0..4>()` |

| Node state | Matching selectors | Winner |
|------------|--------------------|--------|
| `PRESSED \| CHECKED` | `CHECKED`, `PRESSED` | `PRESSED` |
| `PRESSED \| CHECKED` | `PRESSED`, `PRESSED \| CHECKED` | `PRESSED \| CHECKED` |
| `DISABLED \| PRESSED \| CHECKED` | `DISABLED`, `PRESSED \| CHECKED` | `DISABLED` |
| `DISABLED \| ALARM` | `DISABLED`, `ALARM` (`custom::<0>()`) | `ALARM` |

Equal state sets fall back to the entry order above. This is LVGL's order, so the built-in
themes look as in LVGL; the order is a documented list, not a property of the bit values
(the bits are laid out to match it, checked at compile time, so a comparison is one integer
compare: `Selector::weight`). The full rule and more examples: `State`.

**Modules at a glance**

| Item | Role | LVGL |
|------|------|------|
| `PropId`, `StyleProp`, `StyleValue`, `PROP_META`, `PROP_NAMES` | the 129 properties, typed values, metadata (hot) and names (diagnostics) | `lv_style_prop_t`, `lv_style_value_t` |
| `Style`, `StyleBuf`, `StyleRef`, `style!`, `StyleContainer` | containers and their composition (`..BASE` spread, `Style::merge`, `StyleBuf::extend_from`) | `lv_style_t`, `LV_STYLE_CONST_INIT` |
| `Part`, `State` (`State::custom`, `State::PRECEDENCE`), `Selector` | selectors, application states, state precedence | `lv_part_t`, `lv_state_t`, `lv_style_selector_t` |
| `resolve`, `StyleSource` | resolution | `lv_obj_get_style_prop` |
| `design` (`ThemeMode`, `design::ElementTable`, `design::DesignSet` and the typed sets, `design::ContrastPair`, `design::SURFACE`, …), `elements!` | design elements: named values the theme supplies per mode (const tables in flash), application element sets, and each mode's contrast requirements | — |
| `GridTracks`, `SharedTracks`, `TracksRef`, `resolve_grid_tracks` | grid templates in styles (`'static`, or run-time ones owned by their container) | `lv_style_set_grid_*_dsc_array` |
| `Transition`, `Props`, `TransitionRef`, `interpolate` | transitions: what animates (a property set or the properties a state change alters) and how (`AnimSpec`) | `lv_style_transition_dsc_t`, `trans_anim_cb` |

**Features**

`log` / `defmt` select the logging backend (target `"twine::style"`); `std` enables std-only
conveniences of the dependencies.

`safety`: the safety profile (enabled by the `twine` facade's `safety` feature, see
`docs/safety/profile.md` in the repository): the profile's lints.

#### enum twine_style::ThemeMode
The mode of a theme: which of its element tables is active. Switching the mode (`Engine::set_theme_mode` in `twine-engine`, `ThemeHandle::set_mode` in `twine-view`) swaps the table, so everything styled with design elements changes at once.
Variants:
- `Light` — Light screens and cards, dark text: daylight, offices, indoor use.
- `Dark` — Dark screens and cards, light text: dim rooms, less emitted light on emissive panels.
- `Night` — Night operation — cockpits, vehicle dashboards, control rooms and bedside equipment at night: a dark, **dimmed, low-luminance** palette with **reduced blue** (warm amber and red tones), which preserves the operator's dark adaptation and limits glare and reflections (e.g. in a windshield or canopy). The built-in color themes keep every color at most 30 % relative luminance (white is 100 %) and its blue channel at most half its red channel; text still meets 4.5:1. Dimming the panel itself is the backlight's job (the application's); a monochrome theme can only invert (white on black, like `Dark`).
- `HighContrast` — Maximum legibility — bright sunlight, low vision, safety-relevant readouts: black and white with saturated accents, opaque focus rings, no shadows. Text meets 7:1 (WCAG AAA), the focus ring and disabled content 4.5:1 (see `min_contrast`).
Methods of `ThemeMode`:
- `const ALL: [twine_style::ThemeMode; 4]` — Every mode, in the order a mode switch cycles through them.
- `pub const fn name(self) -> &'static str` — A stable `snake_case` name for logs and audit reports (`"light"`, `"dark"`, `"night"`, `"high_contrast"`).
- `pub const fn min_contrast(self, pair: twine_style::design::ContrastPair) -> Option<twine_core::color::ContrastRatio>` — The minimum WCAG contrast ratio `pair` must reach in this mode (`None`: no requirement in this mode). The requirements, as hundredths-exact ratios:
- `pub fn next_in(self, modes: &[twine_style::ThemeMode]) -> twine_style::ThemeMode` — The mode after this one in `modes` (wrapping around): what a "switch mode" button or hotkey selects next among the modes a theme supports (`ThemeHook::modes`). The first of `modes` if this mode is not in it; this mode if `modes` is empty.
Implements: Copy, Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash

#### static twine_style::PROP_ALIASES
`pub static PROP_ALIASES: [&[&str]; 129]`
The former names of every property, indexed like `PROP_META`: the previous Twine key (when it changed) and the LVGL constant. They are `#[doc(alias)]`es of the property, its builder method and its view modifier, and are listed in `PROPERTIES.md`; `style!` does not accept them. Kept out of `PropMeta` so firmware that never reads it does not link the strings.

#### const twine_style::PROP_COUNT
`pub const PROP_COUNT: usize`
Number of style properties.

#### static twine_style::PROP_META
`pub static PROP_META: [twine_style::PropMeta; 129]`
Metadata of every property, indexed by `id as usize - 1` (use `PropId::meta`).

#### static twine_style::PROP_NAMES
`pub static PROP_NAMES: [twine_style::PropNames; 129]`
The names of every property, indexed like `PROP_META` (use `PropId::names`). Separate from `PROP_META` so firmware that never reads a name does not link the strings.

#### struct twine_style::PropFlags
What a property change affects (LVGL `LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_*`, same bit values).
Methods of `PropFlags`:
- `const INHERITABLE: Self` — Inherited from the parent when not set (`LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_INHERITABLE`).
- `const EXT_DRAW: Self` — Changes the extra draw area around the object (`LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_EXT_DRAW_UPDATE`).
- `const LAYOUT: Self` — Needs a layout update (`LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_LAYOUT_UPDATE`).
- `const PARENT_LAYOUT: Self` — Needs a layout update of the parent (`LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_PARENT_LAYOUT_UPDATE`).
- `const LAYER: Self` — Affects layer handling (`LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_LAYER_UPDATE`).
- `const TRANSFORM: Self` — Affects the object's transformation (`LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_TRANSFORM`).
- `pub const fn empty() -> Self` — Get a flags value with all bits unset.
- `pub const fn all() -> Self` — Get a flags value with all known bits set.
- `pub const fn bits(&self) -> u8` — Get the underlying bits value.
- `pub const fn from_bits(bits: u8) -> Option<Self>` — Convert from a bits value.
- `pub const fn from_bits_truncate(bits: u8) -> Self` — Convert from a bits value, unsetting any unknown bits.
- `pub const fn from_bits_retain(bits: u8) -> Self` — Convert from a bits value exactly.
- `pub fn from_name(name: &str) -> Option<Self>` — Get a flags value with the bits of a flag with the given name set.
- `pub const fn is_empty(&self) -> bool` — Whether all bits in `self` are unset.
- `pub const fn is_all(&self) -> bool` — Whether all known bits in this flags value are set.
- `pub const fn intersects(&self, other: Self) -> bool` — Whether any set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.
- `pub const fn contains(&self, other: Self) -> bool` — Whether all set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.
- `pub fn insert(&mut self, other: Self)` — The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub fn remove(&mut self, other: Self)` — The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).
- `pub fn toggle(&mut self, other: Self)` — The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub fn set(&mut self, other: Self, value: bool)` — Call `insert` when `value` is `true` or `remove` when `value` is `false`.
- `pub const fn intersection(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub const fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub const fn difference(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).
- `pub const fn symmetric_difference(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub const fn complement(self) -> Self` — The bitwise negation (`!`) of the bits in `self`, truncating the result.
- `pub const fn iter(&self) -> bitflags::iter::Iter<twine_style::PropFlags>` — Yield a set of contained flags values.
- `pub const fn iter_names(&self) -> bitflags::iter::IterNames<twine_style::PropFlags>` — Yield a set of contained named flags values.
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Flags, PublicFlags, Binary, Octal, LowerHex, UpperHex, BitOr, BitOrAssign, BitXor, BitXorAssign, BitAnd, BitAndAssign, Sub, SubAssign, Not, Extend<twine_style::PropFlags>, FromIterator<twine_style::PropFlags>, IntoIterator

#### enum twine_style::PropId
Identifier of a style property: the fieldless discriminant of `StyleProp` (`1..=PROP_COUNT`; LVGL `lv_style_prop_t`, with Twine's own numbering and names).
Variants:
- `Width = { _ }` — Width (`LV_STYLE_WIDTH`). Default `Content` (LVGL: widget class dependent).
- `MinWidth = { _ }` — Minimal width (`LV_STYLE_MIN_WIDTH`); percent of the parent's content width.
- `MaxWidth = { _ }` — Maximal width (`LV_STYLE_MAX_WIDTH`).
- `Height = { _ }` — Height (`LV_STYLE_HEIGHT`). Default `Content` (LVGL: widget class dependent).
- `MinHeight = { _ }` — Minimal height (`LV_STYLE_MIN_HEIGHT`).
- `MaxHeight = { _ }` — Maximal height (`LV_STYLE_MAX_HEIGHT`).
- `X = { _ }` — X position relative to the `Align` reference (`LV_STYLE_X`).
- `Y = { _ }` — Y position relative to the `Align` reference (`LV_STYLE_Y`).
- `Align = { _ }` — Alignment in the parent (`LV_STYLE_ALIGN`).
- `TransformWidth = { _ }` — Draws the object wider on both sides; percent of its width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_WIDTH`).
- `TransformHeight = { _ }` — Draws the object taller on both sides (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_HEIGHT`).
- `TranslateX = { _ }` — Moves the object after layout; percent of its width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_X`).
- `TranslateY = { _ }` — Moves the object after layout; percent of its height (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_Y`).
- `TranslateRadial = { _ }` — Moves radial items (e.g. scale labels) outward (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_RADIAL`).
- `TransformScaleX = { _ }` — Horizontal zoom (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SCALE_X`).
- `TransformScaleY = { _ }` — Vertical zoom (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SCALE_Y`).
- `TransformRotation = { _ }` — Rotation (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_ROTATION`).
- `TransformPivotX = { _ }` — Pivot of rotation/zoom from the left edge; percent of the width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_PIVOT_X`).
- `TransformPivotY = { _ }` — Pivot of rotation/zoom from the top edge (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_PIVOT_Y`).
- `TransformSkewX = { _ }` — Horizontal skew (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SKEW_X`).
- `TransformSkewY = { _ }` — Vertical skew (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SKEW_Y`).
- `PaddingTop = { _ }` — Top padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_TOP`).
- `PaddingBottom = { _ }` — Bottom padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_BOTTOM`).
- `PaddingLeft = { _ }` — Left padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_LEFT`).
- `PaddingRight = { _ }` — Right padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_RIGHT`).
- `RowGap = { _ }` — Gap between rows of a flex or grid container (`LV_STYLE_PAD_ROW`).
- `ColumnGap = { _ }` — Gap between columns of a flex or grid container (`LV_STYLE_PAD_COLUMN`).
- `PaddingRadial = { _ }` — Radial padding of radial items (`LV_STYLE_PAD_RADIAL`).
- `MarginTop = { _ }` — Top margin, used by flex/grid placement (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_TOP`).
- `MarginBottom = { _ }` — Bottom margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_BOTTOM`).
- `MarginLeft = { _ }` — Left margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_LEFT`).
- `MarginRight = { _ }` — Right margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_RIGHT`).
- `BgColor = { _ }` — Background color (`LV_STYLE_BG_COLOR`); transparent until `bg_opacity` is set (the `bg` shorthand sets both).
- `BgOpacity = { _ }` — Background opacity (`LV_STYLE_BG_OPA`).
- `BgGradientColor = { _ }` — Gradient end color for `Ver`/`Hor` gradients (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_COLOR`).
- `BgGradientDir = { _ }` — Simple gradient direction (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_DIR`).
- `BgGradientStart = { _ }` — Where the gradient starts along the object (`LV_STYLE_BG_MAIN_STOP`).
- `BgGradientEnd = { _ }` — Where the gradient ends along the object (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_STOP`).
- `BgGradientStartOpacity = { _ }` — Opacity of the gradient's start color (`LV_STYLE_BG_MAIN_OPA`).
- `BgGradientEndOpacity = { _ }` — Opacity of the gradient's end color (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_OPA`).
- `BgGradient = { _ }` — Full gradient descriptor; overrides the simple gradient (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD`).
- `BgImage = { _ }` — Background image or symbol (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_SRC`).
- `BgImageOpacity = { _ }` — Background image opacity (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_OPA`).
- `BgImageRecolor = { _ }` — Background image recolor (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_RECOLOR`).
- `BgImageRecolorOpacity = { _ }` — Background image recolor intensity (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_RECOLOR_OPA`).
- `BgImageTiled = { _ }` — Tile the background image (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_TILED`).
- `BorderColor = { _ }` — Border color (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_COLOR`).
- `BorderOpacity = { _ }` — Border opacity (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_OPA`).
- `BorderWidth = { _ }` — Border width (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_WIDTH`).
- `BorderSide = { _ }` — Which sides get a border (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_SIDE`).
- `BorderAboveChildren = { _ }` — Draw the border after (above) the children (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_POST`).
- `OutlineWidth = { _ }` — Outline width (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_WIDTH`).
- `OutlineColor = { _ }` — Outline color (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_COLOR`).
- `OutlineOpacity = { _ }` — Outline opacity (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_OPA`).

- `ShadowWidth = { _ }` — Shadow blur width (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_WIDTH`).

- `ShadowOffsetY = { _ }` — Shadow vertical offset (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_OFFSET_Y`).

- `BlurBackdrop = { _ }` — Blur what is behind the part instead of the part itself (`LV_STYLE_BLUR_BACKDROP`).
- `BlurQuality = { _ }` — Blur quality (`LV_STYLE_BLUR_QUALITY`).
- `ImageOpacity = { _ }` — Image opacity (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_OPA`).
- `ImageRecolor = { _ }` — Image recolor (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_RECOLOR`).
- `ImageRecolorOpacity = { _ }` — Image recolor intensity (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_RECOLOR_OPA`).

- `GridColumnTracks = { _ }` — Column template: the column tracks, a `GridTracks` (`style!` takes a `'static` slice or array only; build others with `grid_tracks!`) (`LV_STYLE_GRID_COLUMN_DSC_ARRAY`).
- `GridRowTracks = { _ }` — Row template: the row tracks, a `GridTracks` (`style!` takes a `'static` slice or array only) (`LV_STYLE_GRID_ROW_DSC_ARRAY`).
- `GridColumnAlign = { _ }` — Column track alignment (`LV_STYLE_GRID_COLUMN_ALIGN`).
- `GridRowAlign = { _ }` — Row track alignment (`LV_STYLE_GRID_ROW_ALIGN`).
- `GridCellColumn = { _ }` — Cell column (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_COLUMN_POS`).
- `GridCellColumnSpan = { _ }` — Cell column span (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_COLUMN_SPAN`).
- `GridCellXAlign = { _ }` — Horizontal alignment in the cell (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_X_ALIGN`).
- `GridCellRow = { _ }` — Cell row (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_ROW_POS`).
- `GridCellRowSpan = { _ }` — Cell row span (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_ROW_SPAN`).
- `GridCellYAlign = { _ }` — Vertical alignment in the cell (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_Y_ALIGN`).
Methods of `PropId`:
- `const ALL: [twine_style::PropId; 129]` — Every property, in id order.
- `pub const fn from_u8(v: u8) -> Option<twine_style::PropId>` — The property with id `v` (`None` for 0 and ids past `PROP_COUNT`).
- `pub const fn meta(self) -> &'static twine_style::PropMeta` — The property's metadata.
- `pub const fn group(self) -> u8` — Lookup group: `id >> 4` (see `Style::has_group`).
- `pub const fn group_bit(self) -> u16` — Bit of this property's group in a `has_group` mask.
- `pub const fn names(self) -> &'static twine_style::PropNames` — The property's names (see `PropNames`).
- `pub const fn name(self) -> &'static str` — Property name (`"BgColor"`).
- `pub const fn snake_name(self) -> &'static str` — The property's key: its `style!` key, `StyleBuf` builder method and view modifier (`"bg_color"`).
- `pub const fn type_name(self) -> &'static str` — Rust payload type of the property's `StyleProp` variant (`"ColorValue"`).
Implements: Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Display, Debug, From<twine_style::PropId>, FromIterator<twine_style::PropId>, BitOr<twine_style::PropId>, BitOrAssign<twine_style::PropId>, Sub<twine_style::PropId>

#### struct twine_style::PropMeta
Static metadata of one property (see `PROP_META`): what resolution, invalidation and layout read on every style lookup. The property's names are in `PropNames` (`PROP_NAMES`), kept apart so that firmware that never prints a property name does not link the strings (about 3 KiB of names plus 24 bytes of `&str`s per property).
Fields:
- `inherited: bool` — Inherited from the parent's `Main` part when not set.
- `layout: bool` — A change needs a layout update.
- `ext_draw: bool` — A change may change the extra draw area (shadow, outline, transforms…).
- `flags: twine_style::PropFlags` — Every LVGL flag of the property.
- `default: twine_style::StyleValue` — Value when no style sets the property (LVGL `lv_style_prop_get_default`). `Font` holds `twine_text::EMPTY_FONT`; resolution substitutes the caller's `StyleDefaults::font`.
- `group: u8` — Lookup group, `id >> 4` (see `Style::has_group`; an index for fast lookups, not the property group of `Props`).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug

#### struct twine_style::PropNames
The names of one property (see `PROP_NAMES` and `PropId::names`): for diagnostics, tools and generated documentation. Nothing on the rendering path reads them, so they are linked only into programs that do (the `Display` of `PropId`, `log`-backend messages, tools); `defmt` logs print a `PropId` through its interned `defmt::Format` instead.
Fields:
- `name: &'static str` — Property name (`"BgColor"`), the variant of `PropId` and `StyleProp`.
- `snake_name: &'static str` — The property's key: the `style!` key, the `StyleBuf` builder method and the view modifier (`"bg_color"`).
- `type_name: &'static str` — Rust payload type of the `StyleProp` variant (`"ColorValue"`: a color or a design element).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq

#### enum twine_style::StyleProp
One style property with its value: one variant per `PropId`, with the natural payload type. `Copy`; lives in `static` `Style`s or in `StyleBuf`s. A grid template property holds a `TracksRef`: a `'static` list, or the run-time template its container (a `StyleBuf`) holds.
Variants:
- `Width(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Width (`LV_STYLE_WIDTH`). Default `Content` (LVGL: widget class dependent).
- `MinWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Minimal width (`LV_STYLE_MIN_WIDTH`); percent of the parent's content width.
- `MaxWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Maximal width (`LV_STYLE_MAX_WIDTH`).
- `Height(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Height (`LV_STYLE_HEIGHT`). Default `Content` (LVGL: widget class dependent).
- `MinHeight(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Minimal height (`LV_STYLE_MIN_HEIGHT`).
- `MaxHeight(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Maximal height (`LV_STYLE_MAX_HEIGHT`).
- `X(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — X position relative to the `Align` reference (`LV_STYLE_X`).
- `Y(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Y position relative to the `Align` reference (`LV_STYLE_Y`).
- `Align(twine_style::Align)` — Alignment in the parent (`LV_STYLE_ALIGN`).
- `TransformWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Draws the object wider on both sides; percent of its width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_WIDTH`).
- `TransformHeight(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Draws the object taller on both sides (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_HEIGHT`).
- `TranslateX(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Moves the object after layout; percent of its width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_X`).
- `TranslateY(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Moves the object after layout; percent of its height (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_Y`).
- `TranslateRadial(i32)` — Moves radial items (e.g. scale labels) outward (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_RADIAL`).
- `TransformScaleX(twine_core::Scale)` — Horizontal zoom (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SCALE_X`).
- `TransformScaleY(twine_core::Scale)` — Vertical zoom (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SCALE_Y`).
- `TransformRotation(twine_core::Angle)` — Rotation (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_ROTATION`).
- `TransformPivotX(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Pivot of rotation/zoom from the left edge; percent of the width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_PIVOT_X`).
- `TransformPivotY(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Pivot of rotation/zoom from the top edge (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_PIVOT_Y`).
- `TransformSkewX(twine_core::Angle)` — Horizontal skew (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SKEW_X`).
- `TransformSkewY(twine_core::Angle)` — Vertical skew (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SKEW_Y`).
- `PaddingTop(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Top padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_TOP`).
- `PaddingBottom(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Bottom padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_BOTTOM`).
- `PaddingLeft(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Left padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_LEFT`).
- `PaddingRight(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Right padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_RIGHT`).
- `RowGap(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Gap between rows of a flex or grid container (`LV_STYLE_PAD_ROW`).
- `ColumnGap(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Gap between columns of a flex or grid container (`LV_STYLE_PAD_COLUMN`).
- `PaddingRadial(i32)` — Radial padding of radial items (`LV_STYLE_PAD_RADIAL`).
- `MarginTop(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Top margin, used by flex/grid placement (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_TOP`).
- `MarginBottom(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Bottom margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_BOTTOM`).
- `MarginLeft(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Left margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_LEFT`).
- `MarginRight(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Right margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_RIGHT`).
- `BgColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Background color (`LV_STYLE_BG_COLOR`); transparent until `bg_opacity` is set (the `bg` shorthand sets both).
- `BgOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Background opacity (`LV_STYLE_BG_OPA`).
- `BgGradientColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Gradient end color for `Ver`/`Hor` gradients (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_COLOR`).
- `BgGradientDir(twine_style::GradDir)` — Simple gradient direction (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_DIR`).
- `BgGradientStart(twine_core::Fraction)` — Where the gradient starts along the object (`LV_STYLE_BG_MAIN_STOP`).
- `BgGradientEnd(twine_core::Fraction)` — Where the gradient ends along the object (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_STOP`).
- `BgGradientStartOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Opacity of the gradient's start color (`LV_STYLE_BG_MAIN_OPA`).
- `BgGradientEndOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Opacity of the gradient's end color (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD_OPA`).
- `BgGradient(&'static twine_render::Gradient)` — Full gradient descriptor; overrides the simple gradient (`LV_STYLE_BG_GRAD`).
- `BgImage(twine_style::design::IconValue)` — Background image or symbol (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_SRC`).
- `BgImageOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Background image opacity (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_OPA`).
- `BgImageRecolor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Background image recolor (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_RECOLOR`).
- `BgImageRecolorOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Background image recolor intensity (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_RECOLOR_OPA`).
- `BgImageTiled(bool)` — Tile the background image (`LV_STYLE_BG_IMAGE_TILED`).
- `BorderColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Border color (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_COLOR`).
- `BorderOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Border opacity (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_OPA`).
- `BorderWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Border width (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_WIDTH`).
- `BorderSide(twine_render::BorderSide)` — Which sides get a border (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_SIDE`).
- `BorderAboveChildren(bool)` — Draw the border after (above) the children (`LV_STYLE_BORDER_POST`).
- `OutlineWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Outline width (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_WIDTH`).
- `OutlineColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Outline color (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_COLOR`).
- `OutlineOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Outline opacity (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_OPA`).
- `OutlineOffset(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Gap between the object and the outline (`LV_STYLE_OUTLINE_PAD`).
- `ShadowWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Shadow blur width (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_WIDTH`).
- `ShadowOffsetX(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Shadow horizontal offset (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_OFFSET_X`).
- `ShadowOffsetY(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Shadow vertical offset (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_OFFSET_Y`).
- `ShadowSpread(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Shadow spread (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_SPREAD`).
- `ShadowColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Shadow color (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_COLOR`).
- `ShadowOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Shadow opacity (`LV_STYLE_SHADOW_OPA`).
- `DropShadowRadius(i32)` — Drop shadow blur radius (`LV_STYLE_DROP_SHADOW_RADIUS`).
- `DropShadowOffsetX(i32)` — Drop shadow horizontal offset (`LV_STYLE_DROP_SHADOW_OFFSET_X`).
- `DropShadowOffsetY(i32)` — Drop shadow vertical offset (`LV_STYLE_DROP_SHADOW_OFFSET_Y`).
- `DropShadowColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Drop shadow color (`LV_STYLE_DROP_SHADOW_COLOR`).
- `DropShadowOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Drop shadow opacity (`LV_STYLE_DROP_SHADOW_OPA`).
- `DropShadowQuality(twine_style::BlurQuality)` — Drop shadow blur quality (`LV_STYLE_DROP_SHADOW_QUALITY`).
- `BlurRadius(i32)` — Blur radius of the part (`LV_STYLE_BLUR_RADIUS`).
- `BlurBackdrop(bool)` — Blur what is behind the part instead of the part itself (`LV_STYLE_BLUR_BACKDROP`).
- `BlurQuality(twine_style::BlurQuality)` — Blur quality (`LV_STYLE_BLUR_QUALITY`).
- `ImageOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Image opacity (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_OPA`).
- `ImageRecolor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Image recolor (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_RECOLOR`).
- `ImageRecolorOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Image recolor intensity (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_RECOLOR_OPA`).
- `ImageColorKey(&'static twine_style::ImageColorkey)` — Colors made transparent in images (`LV_STYLE_IMAGE_COLORKEY`).
- `LineWidth(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Line width (`LV_STYLE_LINE_WIDTH`).
- `LineDashWidth(i32)` — Dash length (`LV_STYLE_LINE_DASH_WIDTH`).
- `LineDashGap(i32)` — Gap between dashes (`LV_STYLE_LINE_DASH_GAP`).

- `LineColor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Line color (`LV_STYLE_LINE_COLOR`).
- `LineOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Line opacity (`LV_STYLE_LINE_OPA`).

- `Font(twine_style::design::FontValue)` — Font, inherited (`LV_STYLE_TEXT_FONT`); the default comes from `StyleDefaults::font`.
- `LetterSpacing(twine_style::design::LengthValue)` — Extra space between letters, inherited (`LV_STYLE_TEXT_LETTER_SPACE`).

- `TextOutlineOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Text outline opacity (`LV_STYLE_TEXT_OUTLINE_STROKE_OPA`).
- `TextLeadingTrim(twine_style::TextLeadingTrim)` — Trims the space above/below text by font metrics, inherited (`LV_STYLE_TEXT_LEADING_TRIM`).
- `Radius(twine_style::design::RadiusValue)` — Corner radius; `Radius::Circle` for fully round (`LV_STYLE_RADIUS`).
- `ClipCorner(bool)` — Clip children to the rounded corners (`LV_STYLE_CLIP_CORNER`).
- `PartOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Opacity factor of the part, multiplied into everything it draws, without a layer (`LV_STYLE_OPA`). Cheaper than `opacity` but overlapping children show through each other.

- `Recolor(twine_style::design::ColorValue)` — Recolor of everything the part draws (`LV_STYLE_RECOLOR`).
- `RecolorOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Recolor intensity (`LV_STYLE_RECOLOR_OPA`).
- `ColorFilter(&'static twine_style::ColorFilter)` — Color filter, inherited (`LV_STYLE_COLOR_FILTER_DSC`).
- `ColorFilterOpacity(twine_style::design::OpacityValue)` — Color filter intensity, inherited (`LV_STYLE_COLOR_FILTER_OPA`).
- `Length(i32)` — Generic length, e.g. of scale ticks (`LV_STYLE_LENGTH`).
- `RadialOffset(i32)` — Offset of radial items (`LV_STYLE_RADIAL_OFFSET`).
- `Anim(twine_style::design::MotionValue)` — Animation timing used by some widgets (`LV_STYLE_ANIM`).
- `AnimDuration(twine_style::DurationMs)` — Animation duration used by some widgets (`LV_STYLE_ANIM_DURATION`).
- `Transition(twine_style::TransitionRef)` — Transition to run when entering the state: which properties animate and how (`LV_STYLE_TRANSITION`; see `Transition`).
- `BlendMode(twine_render::BlendMode)` — How the part blends with what is below (`LV_STYLE_BLEND_MODE`).
- `Layout(twine_style::LayoutKind)` — Layout of the children (`LV_STYLE_LAYOUT`).
- `BaseDir(twine_style::BaseDir)` — Base text direction, inherited (`LV_STYLE_BASE_DIR`).
- `BitmapMask(&'static twine_image::ImageSource)` — A8/L8 image masking the object (`LV_STYLE_BITMAP_MASK_SRC`).
- `RotarySensitivity(twine_style::design::ScaleValue)` — Encoder rotation multiplier (`LV_STYLE_ROTARY_SENSITIVITY`).
- `FlexFlow(twine_style::FlexFlow)` — Flex direction, wrapping and order, e.g. `FlexFlow::COLUMN.wrap(true)` (`LV_STYLE_FLEX_FLOW`).
- `FlexMainAlign(twine_style::MainAlign)` — Placement of the items on the main axis (`LV_STYLE_FLEX_MAIN_PLACE`).
- `FlexCrossAlign(twine_style::CrossAlign)` — Placement of the items across the main axis, in their track (`LV_STYLE_FLEX_CROSS_PLACE`).
- `FlexTrackAlign(twine_style::MainAlign)` — Placement of the tracks of a wrapping container (`LV_STYLE_FLEX_TRACK_PLACE`).
- `FlexGrow(i32)` — Weight of a flex item's share of the free main-axis space: items share it in proportion to their weights (`1` and `3` get a quarter and three quarters); 0 = the item keeps its own size; the layout warns about a negative weight and uses 0, and about a weight above `u16::MAX` (65 535) and uses `u16::MAX` (`LV_STYLE_FLEX_GROW`).
- `GridColumnTracks(twine_style::TracksRef)` — Column template: the column tracks, a `GridTracks` (`style!` takes a `'static` slice or array only; build others with `grid_tracks!`) (`LV_STYLE_GRID_COLUMN_DSC_ARRAY`).
- `GridRowTracks(twine_style::TracksRef)` — Row template: the row tracks, a `GridTracks` (`style!` takes a `'static` slice or array only) (`LV_STYLE_GRID_ROW_DSC_ARRAY`).
- `GridColumnAlign(twine_style::GridAlign)` — Column track alignment (`LV_STYLE_GRID_COLUMN_ALIGN`).
- `GridRowAlign(twine_style::GridAlign)` — Row track alignment (`LV_STYLE_GRID_ROW_ALIGN`).
- `GridCellColumn(i32)` — Cell column (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_COLUMN_POS`).
- `GridCellColumnSpan(i32)` — Cell column span (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_COLUMN_SPAN`).
- `GridCellXAlign(twine_style::GridAlign)` — Horizontal alignment in the cell (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_X_ALIGN`).
- `GridCellRow(i32)` — Cell row (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_ROW_POS`).
- `GridCellRowSpan(i32)` — Cell row span (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_ROW_SPAN`).
- `GridCellYAlign(twine_style::GridAlign)` — Vertical alignment in the cell (`LV_STYLE_GRID_CELL_Y_ALIGN`).
Methods of `StyleProp`:
- `pub const fn id(&self) -> twine_style::PropId` — The property's id.
- `pub fn value(&self) -> twine_style::StyleValue` — The value as a `StyleValue`.
- `pub fn from_value(id: twine_style::PropId, v: twine_style::StyleValue) -> Option<twine_style::StyleProp>` — Builds the property `id` from a value of the matching variant (`None` if the variant or enum code does not fit the property).
- `pub fn tracks_ref(&self) -> Option<twine_style::TracksRef>` — The template of a grid template property (`None` for any other property).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, FromIterator<twine_style::StyleProp>

#### struct twine_style::Props
A set of style properties: one bit per `PropId`, `Copy`, `const`-constructible.
Methods of `Props`:
- `const SIZE: twine_style::Props` — Size: width, height and their limits.
- `const POSITION: twine_style::Props` — Position: `x`, `y` and the alignment in the parent.
- `const TRANSFORM: twine_style::Props` — Transforms applied after layout: translation, scale, rotation, skew, pivot and the drawn size extension.
- `const PADDING: twine_style::Props` — Padding and the gaps between children.
- `const MARGIN: twine_style::Props` — Margins.
- `const BG: twine_style::Props` — Background: color, opacity, gradient and image.
- `const BORDER: twine_style::Props` — Border.
- `const OUTLINE: twine_style::Props` — Outline.
- `const SHADOW: twine_style::Props` — Box shadow.
- `const DROP_SHADOW: twine_style::Props` — Drop shadow (shadow of the drawn content).
- `const BLUR: twine_style::Props` — Blur.
- `const IMAGE: twine_style::Props` — Image drawing (opacity, recolor, color key).
- `const LINE: twine_style::Props` — Line drawing.
- `const ARC: twine_style::Props` — Arc drawing.
- `const TEXT: twine_style::Props` — Text: color, font, spacing, alignment, decoration and outline.
- `const RADIUS: twine_style::Props` — Corner radius and clipping to it.
- `const OPACITY: twine_style::Props` — Opacity of the part and of the whole object.
- `const RECOLOR: twine_style::Props` — Recoloring: recolor and color filter.
- `const MISC: twine_style::Props` — Everything else: generic length, radial offset, animation and transition, blend mode, layout kind, base direction, bitmap mask, rotary sensitivity.
- `const FLEX: twine_style::Props` — Flex layout.
- `const GRID: twine_style::Props` — Grid layout.
- `const GROUPS: &'static [(&'static str, twine_style::Props)]` — Every property group with its name (`"BG"`), in table order. The groups are disjoint and together contain every property.
- `const EMPTY: twine_style::Props` — No property.
- `const ALL: twine_style::Props` — Every property.
- `const INTERPOLABLE: twine_style::Props` — Every property whose values change gradually during a transition (integers, lengths, colors, opacities, angles, scales: see `is_interpolable`). The others (fonts, images, enums, flags, references, grid templates) switch at once or at the end of a transition.
- `pub const fn of(id: twine_style::PropId) -> twine_style::Props` — The set of `id`.
- `pub const fn from_ids(ids: &[twine_style::PropId]) -> twine_style::Props` — The set of `ids` (duplicates are fine).
- `pub const fn with(self, id: twine_style::PropId) -> twine_style::Props` — This set plus `id`.
- `pub const fn without(self, id: twine_style::PropId) -> twine_style::Props` — This set without `id`.
- `pub const fn union(self, other: twine_style::Props) -> twine_style::Props` — The members of either set. `const` form of `|`.
- `pub const fn intersection(self, other: twine_style::Props) -> twine_style::Props` — The members of both sets. `const` form of `&`.
- `pub const fn difference(self, other: twine_style::Props) -> twine_style::Props` — The members of this set that are not in `other`. `const` form of `-`.
- `pub const fn contains(&self, id: twine_style::PropId) -> bool` — Whether `id` is a member.
- `pub const fn is_empty(&self) -> bool` — Whether the set is empty.
- `pub const fn len(&self) -> usize` — Number of members.
- `pub fn iter(self) -> impl Iterator<Item = twine_style::PropId>` — The members in id order (visits set bits only).
Implements: Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default, From<twine_style::PropId>, FromIterator<twine_style::PropId>, BitOr, BitOr<twine_style::PropId>, BitOrAssign, BitOrAssign<twine_style::PropId>, BitAnd, BitAndAssign, Sub, Sub<twine_style::PropId>, Not, Debug

#### enum twine_style::EntryKind
Where a style entry comes from; the order of an entry list is highest priority first: transitions, local, normal (latest added first), theme.
Variants:
- `Transition` — A running style transition (LVGL `is_trans`): consulted first, by part only.
- `Local` — The node's local style for one selector (LVGL `is_local`).
- `Normal` — A style added to the node (LVGL `lv_obj_add_style`).
- `Theme` — A style added by the theme (LVGL `is_theme`).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash

#### struct twine_style::EntryTrace
One entry examined during a traced resolution (see `resolve_traced`).
Fields:
- `depth: u16` — Number of parent steps from the queried node (0 = the node itself).
- `part: twine_style::Part` — Part looked up at this node (`Main` once inheritance started).
- `entry_index: usize` — Index in the node's entry list.
- `kind: twine_style::EntryKind` — Entry kind.
- `selector: twine_style::Selector` — Entry selector.
- `matched: bool` — The selector applies (for transitions: the part matches and transitions are not skipped).
- `had_prop: bool` — The entry's style sets the property.
- `weight: u16` — Selector weight (`Selector::weight`: the precedence mask of its states).
- `chosen: bool` — This entry provided the resolved value.
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq

#### struct twine_style::ResolveOptions
Options of `resolve_with` for the queried node (not its ancestors).
Fields:
- `state: Option<twine_style::State>` — Resolve as if the node were in this state (LVGL sets `obj->state` temporarily to compare the old and the new state of a transition).
- `skip_transitions: bool` — Ignore the node's transition entries (LVGL `obj->skip_trans`).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq

#### struct twine_style::StyleDefaults
Defaults that depend on the environment rather than on the property (LVGL `LV_FONT_DEFAULT`): the engine passes the theme's normal font.
Fields:
- `font: &'static twine_text::Font` — Default `Font`.
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, Default

#### struct twine_style::StyleEntry
One style attached to a node.
Fields:
- `selector: twine_style::Selector` — Part and states the style applies to.
- `style: twine_style::StyleRef` — The style.
- `kind: twine_style::EntryKind` — Origin (priority class).
Methods of `StyleEntry`:
- `pub fn new(selector: twine_style::Selector, style: impl Into<twine_style::StyleRef>, kind: twine_style::EntryKind) -> Self` — An entry.
Implements: Clone, Debug

#### trait twine_style::StyleSource
`pub trait StyleSource`
A tree of nodes with style entries, as the resolver sees it (the engine's widget tree, or a toy tree in tests).
Items:
- `type Id: Copy` — Node handle.
- `fn entries(&self, id: Self::Id) -> &[twine_style::StyleEntry]` — The node's entries in priority order (highest first): transitions, local, normal (latest added first), theme. The order is the contract; the resolver does not sort.
- `fn state(&self, id: Self::Id) -> twine_style::State` — The node's current state.
- `fn parent(&self, id: Self::Id) -> Option<Self::Id>` — The parent node, `None` for a root.
- `fn dpi(&self, id: Self::Id) -> u16 (provided)` — The DPI that density-independent lengths (`Length::Dp`) of `id` resolve with (the engine: the DPI of the node's display). The resolver calls it only when the winning value is a `Dp` length, so it may be slow (e.g. walk to the root). Default: `REFERENCE_DPI`, i.e. 1 dp = 1 px.
- `fn design_value(&self, id: Self::Id, element: twine_style::design::ElementRef) -> Option<twine_style::StyleValue> (provided)` — The value the theme of `id` gives the design element `element` (the engine: the element table of the node's display), `None` if it does not define it. The resolver calls it only when the winning value is an element, so a style without elements never pays for it. Default: `None` (the element resolves to the property's default, see `resolve`).

#### enum twine_style::TraceEvent<Id>
A step of a traced resolution.
Variants:
- `Entry(twine_style::EntryTrace)` — An entry was examined.
- `Inherited { node: Id, part: twine_style::Part, depth: u16 }` — Not found; the inherited property continues at `node`'s `part` (first the node's own `Main` part when the query was for another part, then each parent's `Main` part).
- `Default(twine_style::StyleValue)` — No entry set the property: the default is used.
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq

#### fn twine_style::resolve
`pub fn resolve<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> twine_style::StyleValue`
Resolves `prop` for `part` of node `id`: the LVGL `lv_obj_get_style_prop` algorithm.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_angle
`pub fn resolve_angle<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> twine_core::Angle`
`resolve` for angle properties.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_as
`pub fn resolve_as<T: twine_style::PropValue, S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> Option<T>`
`resolve` converted to the property's payload type `T` (enums, references…); `None` for unset reference properties (LVGL `NULL`).

#### fn twine_style::resolve_bool
`pub fn resolve_bool<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> bool`

`pub fn resolve_color<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> twine_core::Color`
`resolve` for color properties.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_font
`pub fn resolve_font<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> &'static twine_text::Font`
`resolve` for `Font` (`defaults.font` when no style sets it).

#### fn twine_style::resolve_grid_tracks
`pub fn resolve_grid_tracks<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, opts: twine_style::ResolveOptions) -> Option<&[twine_style::GridTrack]>`
The tracks of grid template property `prop` (`GridColumnTracks` / `GridRowTracks`) for `part` of `id`: the template of the style entry that wins the cascade (`resolve`'s rules; templates are not inherited), borrowed from that entry's style. A `'static` list or a run-time template held by a `StyleBuf` is read through the style that holds it, so it is always the winning style's own, live list. `None` when no style sets the property.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_i32
`pub fn resolve_i32<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> i32`
`resolve` for integer and pixel-length properties such as paddings (`0` if unset; a density-independent length in pixels for `StyleSource::dpi`).

#### fn twine_style::resolve_length
`pub fn resolve_length<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> twine_style::Length`
`resolve` for length properties.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_local_only
`pub fn resolve_local_only<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId) -> Option<twine_style::StyleValue>`
The value set by the node's own entries for `part` in its current state, without inheritance or default (LVGL `get_prop_core`; e.g. "does any style set this property"). Design elements and `Dp` lengths are finished like in `resolve` (an element the source does not define gives the property's default with an empty default font).

#### fn twine_style::resolve_opa
`pub fn resolve_opa<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> twine_core::Opa`
`resolve` for opacity properties.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_scale
`pub fn resolve_scale<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults) -> twine_core::Scale`
`resolve` for scale properties.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_traced
`pub fn resolve_traced<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults, trace: &mut dyn FnMut(twine_style::TraceEvent<<S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id>)) -> twine_style::StyleValue`
`resolve` reporting every examined entry, inheritance step and the default to `trace` (for debugging and the `style_resolve` example; also logs at `trace` level to `"twine::style"`). Returns the same value as `resolve`.

#### fn twine_style::resolve_value
`pub fn resolve_value<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults, v: twine_style::StyleValue) -> twine_style::StyleValue`
Finishes a value read straight from a style (`Style::get`, `StyleBuf::get`) the way `resolve` finishes the value it found: a design element becomes the value `StyleSource::design_value` of `id` gives it (the property's default if none), a `Dp` length becomes pixels for `StyleSource::dpi` of `id`; anything else is returned unchanged. For code that keeps its own small styles outside the cascade (e.g. the spans of a span group).

#### fn twine_style::resolve_with
`pub fn resolve_with<S: twine_style::StyleSource>(src: &S, id: <S as twine_style::StyleSource>::Id, part: twine_style::Part, prop: twine_style::PropId, defaults: &twine_style::StyleDefaults, opts: twine_style::ResolveOptions) -> twine_style::StyleValue`
`resolve` with options for the queried node (state override, skipping transitions).

#### enum twine_style::Part
A part of a widget (LVGL `lv_part_t`; the values here are LVGL's shifted right by 16).
Variants:
- `Main = 0x00` — `LV_PART_MAIN`: the background rectangle.
- `Scrollbar = 0x01` — `LV_PART_SCROLLBAR`
- `Indicator = 0x02` — `LV_PART_INDICATOR`: e.g. the bar/slider/switch indicator, the checkbox tick box.
- `Knob = 0x03` — `LV_PART_KNOB`: a handle to grab.
- `Selected = 0x04` — `LV_PART_SELECTED`: the selected option or section.
- `Items = 0x05` — `LV_PART_ITEMS`: repeated elements (table cells, buttons of a button matrix).
- `Cursor = 0x06` — `LV_PART_CURSOR`: a marker, e.g. the text area cursor.
- `Custom0 = 0x08` — Custom part 0 (`Part::custom::<0>()`, LVGL `LV_PART_CUSTOM_FIRST`).
- `Custom1 = 0x09` — Custom part 1 (`Part::custom::<1>()`).
- `Custom2 = 0x0A` — Custom part 2 (`Part::custom::<2>()`).
- `Custom3 = 0x0B` — Custom part 3 (`Part::custom::<3>()`).
- `Custom4 = 0x0C` — Custom part 4 (`Part::custom::<4>()`).
- `Custom5 = 0x0D` — Custom part 5 (`Part::custom::<5>()`).
- `Custom6 = 0x0E` — Custom part 6 (`Part::custom::<6>()`).
- `Any = 0x0F` — `LV_PART_ANY`: in a selector, matches every part (a Twine extension for style lookup; LVGL uses it only to address all parts when removing styles).
Methods of `Part`:
- `const CUSTOM_COUNT: usize` — How many custom parts exist: `Part::custom::<0>()` to `custom::<6>()` (LVGL's part values `LV_PART_CUSTOM_FIRST` … `LV_PART_ANY - 1`).
- `pub const fn custom<const N: usize>() -> twine_style::Part` — Custom part number `N` (`0..``CUSTOM_COUNT`), for a part of a custom widget the built-in parts do not describe (see `Part`). An `N` out of range is a compile-time error, so this never panics at run time.
- `pub const fn custom_index(self) -> Option<usize>` — The number of a custom part (`Some(N)` for `Part::custom::<N>()`), `None` for the built-in parts and `Part::Any`.
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, From<twine_style::Part>

#### struct twine_style::Selector
A part plus the states in which a style applies (LVGL `lv_style_selector_t` = `part | state`).
Fields:
- `part: twine_style::Part` — The part.
- `state: twine_style::State` — The states that must all be active (empty = any state).
Methods of `Selector`:
- `const MAIN: twine_style::Selector` — `Part::Main` in every state (LVGL selector `0`).
- `pub const fn part(p: twine_style::Part) -> Self` — `p` in every state.
- `pub const fn state(s: twine_style::State) -> Self` — `Part::Main` when all of `s` are active.
- `pub const fn with_state(self, s: twine_style::State) -> Self` — The same part when all of `s` are active.
- `pub fn part_matches(&self, part: twine_style::Part) -> bool` — Whether the part matches: equal, or the selector's part is `Part::Any`.
- `pub fn matches(&self, part: twine_style::Part, node_state: twine_style::State) -> bool` — Whether a style with this selector applies to `part` of a node in `node_state`: the part matches (`part_matches`) and the states do (`state_matches`).
- `pub fn state_matches(&self, node_state: twine_style::State) -> bool` — Whether the selector's states apply to a node in `node_state`: every selector state is active (LVGL: `(state_act & ~node_state) == 0`), or the selector's state is `State::ANY` (every state). The one test every part of Twine uses (resolution, state changes, transitions).
- `pub fn weight(&self) -> u16` — Precedence among matching selectors: the higher weight wins (see State precedence for the rule and the table).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, From<twine_style::Part>, From<twine_style::State>

#### struct twine_style::State
Widget states. A widget can be in several at once; `State::DEFAULT` is the empty set.
Methods of `State`:
- `const DEFAULT: Self` — `LV_STATE_DEFAULT`: no state (every selector state is a superset).
- `const ALT: Self` — `LV_STATE_ALT`: alternative look (e.g. a dark variant), lowest precedence.
- `const CHECKED: Self` — `LV_STATE_CHECKED`: toggled or checked.
- `const FOCUSED: Self` — `LV_STATE_FOCUSED`: focused by keypad/encoder or clicked.
- `const FOCUS_KEY: Self` — `LV_STATE_FOCUS_KEY`: focused by keypad/encoder but not by a pointer.
- `const EDITED: Self` — `LV_STATE_EDITED`: edited by an encoder.
- `const HOVERED: Self` — `LV_STATE_HOVERED`: hovered by a mouse.
- `const PRESSED: Self` — `LV_STATE_PRESSED`: being pressed.
- `const SCROLLED: Self` — `LV_STATE_SCROLLED`: being scrolled.
- `const DISABLED: Self` — `LV_STATE_DISABLED`: disabled.
- `const STALE: Self` — Not in LVGL: the widget shows a value that is too old (a `Validity::Stale` property value). The view layer sets and clears it with the value; the engine marks a stale node with a sparse hatch (its standard look) and themes may style it (R7: the `VALIDITY_INVALID` role's recipe). Ranks above every other built-in state except `INVALID`, so a stale reading never looks like a pressed or disabled one.
- `const INVALID: Self` — Not in LVGL: the widget has no valid value to show (a `Validity::Failed` or `NoData` property value): its text shows dashes and the engine draws a cross-hatch over it (the standard invalid look; themes may style the state further). The highest-ranked built-in state.
- `pub const fn empty() -> Self` — Get a flags value with all bits unset.
- `pub const fn all() -> Self` — Get a flags value with all known bits set.
- `pub const fn bits(&self) -> u16` — Get the underlying bits value.
- `pub const fn from_bits(bits: u16) -> Option<Self>` — Convert from a bits value.
- `pub const fn from_bits_truncate(bits: u16) -> Self` — Convert from a bits value, unsetting any unknown bits.
- `pub const fn from_bits_retain(bits: u16) -> Self` — Convert from a bits value exactly.
- `pub fn from_name(name: &str) -> Option<Self>` — Get a flags value with the bits of a flag with the given name set.
- `pub const fn is_empty(&self) -> bool` — Whether all bits in `self` are unset.
- `pub const fn is_all(&self) -> bool` — Whether all known bits in this flags value are set.
- `pub const fn intersects(&self, other: Self) -> bool` — Whether any set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.
- `pub const fn contains(&self, other: Self) -> bool` — Whether all set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.
- `pub fn insert(&mut self, other: Self)` — The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub fn remove(&mut self, other: Self)` — The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).
- `pub fn toggle(&mut self, other: Self)` — The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub fn set(&mut self, other: Self, value: bool)` — Call `insert` when `value` is `true` or `remove` when `value` is `false`.
- `pub const fn intersection(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub const fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub const fn difference(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).
- `pub const fn symmetric_difference(self, other: Self) -> Self` — The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
- `pub const fn complement(self) -> Self` — The bitwise negation (`!`) of the bits in `self`, truncating the result.
- `pub const fn iter(&self) -> bitflags::iter::Iter<twine_style::State>` — Yield a set of contained flags values.
- `pub const fn iter_names(&self) -> bitflags::iter::IterNames<twine_style::State>` — Yield a set of contained named flags values.
- `const CUSTOM_COUNT: usize` — How many application states exist: `State::custom::<0>()` to `custom::<3>()` (LVGL has the same four, `LV_STATE_USER_1..4`).
- `const CUSTOM_ALL: twine_style::State` — Every application state (`State::custom`) at once, e.g. to clear them all with `set_state(node, State::CUSTOM_ALL, false)`.
- `const ANY: twine_style::State` — Every state, built-in and custom (LVGL `LV_STATE_ANY`, used the same way: as a wildcard).
- `const PRECEDENCE: [twine_style::State; 15]` — The states in precedence order, lowest first (see Precedence): a state outranks every combination of the states before it. `Selector::weight` orders selectors by this list.
- `pub const fn custom<const N: usize>() -> twine_style::State` — The application's state number `N` (`0..``CUSTOM_COUNT`), for a state the built-in ones do not cover (an alarm, a selected row, a read-only field). Custom states rank above every built-in state, and a higher `N` above a lower one (see Precedence). An `N` out of range is a compile-time error, so this never panics at run time.
- `pub fn set_custom_name(state: twine_style::State, name: &str)` — Gives the custom state `state` (one `State::custom` state) a name shown by `Debug`, `Display`, `defmt` and tree dumps instead of `CUSTOM_n`. Call it once at start-up, for example next to the constants. An empty name restores `CUSTOM_n`.
Implements: Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Flags, PublicFlags, Binary, Octal, LowerHex, UpperHex, BitOr, BitOrAssign, BitXor, BitXorAssign, BitAnd, BitAndAssign, Sub, SubAssign, Not, Extend<twine_style::State>, FromIterator<twine_style::State>, IntoIterator, Display, Debug, From<twine_style::State>

#### static twine_style::SHORTHANDS
`pub static SHORTHANDS: &[twine_style::ShorthandMeta]`
Every shorthand, in table order (for documentation and tools).

#### struct twine_style::ShorthandMeta
Static metadata of one shorthand (see `SHORTHANDS`).
Fields:
- `name: &'static str` — Name: the `style!` key, the `StyleBuf` method and the view modifier (`"padding_x"`).
- `params: &'static [(&'static str, &'static str)]` — Parameters as `(name, type)`, in order; `style!` takes several as a tuple.
- `props: &'static [twine_style::PropId]` — The properties it sets, in order (a property may appear once per parameter).
- `aliases: &'static [&'static str]` — Former names (`#[doc(alias)]`es; not accepted by `style!`).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug

#### struct twine_style::Style
An immutable, `const`-constructible style that lives in flash (LVGL `LV_STYLE_CONST_INIT`).
Methods of `Style`:
- `pub const fn new(props: &'static [twine_style::StyleProp]) -> Self` — A style of `props` (the group mask is computed at compile time in `const` context).
- `pub fn get(&self, id: twine_style::PropId) -> Option<twine_style::StyleValue>` — The value of `id`, if set (the last occurrence wins).
- `pub fn grid_tracks(&self, id: twine_style::PropId) -> Option<&'static [twine_style::GridTrack]>` — The tracks of the grid template property `id` (`GridColumnTracks` / `GridRowTracks`), if set.
- `pub fn keys(&self) -> twine_style::Props` — The set of properties this style sets (O(properties); used by transitions that animate what a state change alters).
- `pub fn get_transition(&self) -> Option<&'static twine_style::Transition>` — The `transition` property, if set (a static style holds `'static` transitions only).
- `pub const fn props(&self) -> &'static [twine_style::StyleProp]` — The properties, in declaration order (`const`, so a `style!` spread can read them at compile time).
- `pub const fn has_group(&self) -> u16` — Bit `g` is set iff a property of group `g` (`PropId::group`) is present.
- `pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool` — Whether the style sets no property.
- `pub fn merge(&self, over: &impl twine_style::StyleContainer) -> twine_style::StyleBuf` — Composes at run time: a heap copy of this style with every property of `over` set on top (later wins, like `StyleBuf::set`). `over` may be a `Style`, a `StyleBuf` or a `StyleRef`; a run-time grid template `over` holds is shared by the result (`StyleBuf::extend_from`).
Implements: Clone, Copy, Debug, StyleContainer, From<&twine_style::Style>, From<&'static twine_style::Style>

#### struct twine_style::StyleBuf
A mutable style on the heap (LVGL `lv_style_t` with `lv_style_set_*`).
Methods of `StyleBuf`:
- `pub fn width(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Width (`LV_STYLE_WIDTH`). Default `Content` (LVGL: widget class dependent).
- `pub fn min_width(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Minimal width (`LV_STYLE_MIN_WIDTH`); percent of the parent's content width.
- `pub fn max_width(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Maximal width (`LV_STYLE_MAX_WIDTH`).
- `pub fn height(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Height (`LV_STYLE_HEIGHT`). Default `Content` (LVGL: widget class dependent).
- `pub fn min_height(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Minimal height (`LV_STYLE_MIN_HEIGHT`).
- `pub fn max_height(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Maximal height (`LV_STYLE_MAX_HEIGHT`).
- `pub fn x(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — X position relative to the `Align` reference (`LV_STYLE_X`).
- `pub fn y(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Y position relative to the `Align` reference (`LV_STYLE_Y`).
- `pub fn align(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::Align>) -> Self` — Alignment in the parent (`LV_STYLE_ALIGN`).
- `pub fn transform_width(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Draws the object wider on both sides; percent of its width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_WIDTH`).
- `pub fn transform_height(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Draws the object taller on both sides (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_HEIGHT`).
- `pub fn translate_x(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Moves the object after layout; percent of its width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_X`).
- `pub fn translate_y(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Moves the object after layout; percent of its height (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_Y`).
- `pub fn translate_radial(self, v: impl Into<i32>) -> Self` — Moves radial items (e.g. scale labels) outward (`LV_STYLE_TRANSLATE_RADIAL`).
- `pub fn transform_scale_x(self, v: impl Into<twine_core::Scale>) -> Self` — Horizontal zoom (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SCALE_X`).
- `pub fn transform_scale_y(self, v: impl Into<twine_core::Scale>) -> Self` — Vertical zoom (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SCALE_Y`).
- `pub fn transform_rotation(self, v: impl Into<twine_core::Angle>) -> Self` — Rotation (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_ROTATION`).
- `pub fn transform_pivot_x(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Pivot of rotation/zoom from the left edge; percent of the width (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_PIVOT_X`).
- `pub fn transform_pivot_y(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Pivot of rotation/zoom from the top edge (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_PIVOT_Y`).
- `pub fn transform_skew_x(self, v: impl Into<twine_core::Angle>) -> Self` — Horizontal skew (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SKEW_X`).
- `pub fn transform_skew_y(self, v: impl Into<twine_core::Angle>) -> Self` — Vertical skew (`LV_STYLE_TRANSFORM_SKEW_Y`).
- `pub fn padding_top(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Top padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_TOP`).
- `pub fn padding_bottom(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Bottom padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_BOTTOM`).
- `pub fn padding_left(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Left padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_LEFT`).
- `pub fn padding_right(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Right padding (`LV_STYLE_PAD_RIGHT`).
- `pub fn row_gap(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Gap between rows of a flex or grid container (`LV_STYLE_PAD_ROW`).
- `pub fn column_gap(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Gap between columns of a flex or grid container (`LV_STYLE_PAD_COLUMN`).
- `pub fn padding_radial(self, v: impl Into<i32>) -> Self` — Radial padding of radial items (`LV_STYLE_PAD_RADIAL`).
- `pub fn margin_top(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Top margin, used by flex/grid placement (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_TOP`).
- `pub fn margin_bottom(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Bottom margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_BOTTOM`).
- `pub fn margin_left(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Left margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_LEFT`).
- `pub fn margin_right(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::LengthValue>) -> Self` — Right margin (`LV_STYLE_MARGIN_RIGHT`).
- `pub fn bg_color(self, v: impl Into<twine_style::design::ColorValue>) -> Self` — Background color (`LV_STYLE_BG_COLOR`); transparent until `bg_opacity` is set (the `bg` shorthand sets both).
